text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In what felt like the blink of an eye, the
year
comes to a close and January
begins. Ines Fujin is
now set to embark
on her senior year.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Fu's trainer. Here for a meal
while
you work on New Year's again,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Chatting like this really brings
back
memories. Lemme throw in a
soft-boiled egg—it's
on me!
choice_data_list: Yes, since I'm in the Senior division starting this year!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The line on the left is currently empty,
so please
queue up there!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a happy, happy new year to you,
Trainer! It
never hurts to have a little
extra for those rainy
days, you know!
choice_data_list: Working crowd control for your part-time job again this year?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My mom's going through a rough patch,
so I want
to keep sending money back
home.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I'm saving more than I did before.
This is for
my sisters' sake, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As usual, Ines Fujin's daily life revolves
around
juggling racing with working
part-time jobs to
earn money for her
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But since the Arima Kinen, it's like a
weight has
been lifted from her
shoulders. I've noticed her
running has
become more natural.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Similarly to how overworking the body
can affect
the mind, it appears that
alleviating her mental
burden has had a
beneficial effect on her running.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Nope.
choice_data_list: Looks like there was no need to worry.
Looks like there's no need to worry.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, you didn't ask the ramen
store owner
for any favors or anything,
right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
She suddenly offered to raise my hourly
rate. Said
something about wanting to
repay me a little for
all the good vibes I
bring.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...
Hmmm?
choice_data_list: I'm so glad to hear that!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, I was told you went
there last
New Year's, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! Ramen on the first day of the
new
year?! That can't be good for you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You know, I'd be in a real bind if you
suddenly
got sick due to poor lifestyle
choices!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You need to be careful with your health.
And
make sure you take the medical
checkup that the
academy provides! I
don't care how busy you are!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's good, then.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway... hop in line, Trainer! You're
here to
offer a New Year's prayer, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The third line from the left is moving
quickly! Get
going!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ushered along by Ines Fujin, I join the
line to
offer a prayer. As I'm waiting, I
decide what I
want to wish for this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I put my hands together and pray for
Ines Fujin's
health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwooosh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the harsh winter cold bites my skin, I
suddenly
think of Ines Fujin, still hard at
work organizing
people into lines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Is that for me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's super warm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin must have been feeling the
cold, too.
She clutches the bag with the
bottle of green tea
inside close to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I put my hands together and pray that
all her
future races go well.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! We've finished praying, so let's go
get
fortune slips!

text_block_list.name: Shrine Visitor B
text_block_list.text:
Before we get to that, I want to buy you
a good
luck charm. You've got entrance
exams coming
up, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, a charm? You got one for me,
too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Wishes come true," huh... Did you buy
the same
one for yourself?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I see.
choice_data_list: Yeah! Because I want to keep helping you win!
Yeah! Because I want to keep guiding you to victory!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I guess we match! I'm gonna put
mine on
my bag!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin happily accepts the charm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pray that we'll both improve our skills
over the
coming year so that she can
achieve victory in her
future races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having spent the start of the new year
devising
new plans, I want to hurry and
share the
revamped schedule with Ines
Fujin.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Are you done praying?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
For real? Want to head back together,
then? I've
just finished my shift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I want to discuss this year's
training
schedule with her on our way
back.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, talk about serious! Kicking the
year off a
bit uptight, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But I guess that's just the kind of trainer
I need,
huh? Hehe! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, I discuss the training schedule
we'll be
using for the new year with Ines
Fujin.
